preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 2 and 300,000 inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.
The number of parent indices is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in parents)
preconditions.description: Each parent index is between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of queries is exactly q.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n for vi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query node index is between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of answers is exactly q.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n for ai in answers)
postconditions.description: Each answer is a node index between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(is_centroid_of_subtree(ai, vi) for ai, vi in zip(answers, queries))
postconditions.description: Each answer ai is a centroid of the subtree rooted at the corresponding query node vi.
